# axm lists

Browse curated registry extension lists.

## When to use

Use this when discovering grouped extension recommendations from the registry.

## Usage

```bash
axm lists <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](./global-flags).

## Examples

**Show public lists for @agentxm**

```bash
axm lists list @agentxm
```

**View a list and its items**

```bash
axm lists view @agentxm/starter-kit
```

**Create a list**

```bash
axm lists create @me/favorites --title "Favorites"
```

**Add an extension to a list**

```bash
axm lists add @me/favorites @agentxm/skills/code-review
```

## Subcommands

| Command                               | Summary                                   |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| [axm lists list](#axm-lists-list)     | List curated extension lists for an owner |
| [axm lists view](#axm-lists-view)     | View a curated extension list             |
| [axm lists create](#axm-lists-create) | Create a curated extension list           |
| [axm lists update](#axm-lists-update) | Update a curated extension list           |
| [axm lists delete](#axm-lists-delete) | Delete a curated extension list           |
| [axm lists add](#axm-lists-add)       | Add an extension to a list                |
| [axm lists remove](#axm-lists-remove) | Remove an extension from a list           |

### axm lists list

List curated extension lists for an owner

```bash
axm lists list [flags] <owner>
```

### axm lists view

View a curated extension list

```bash
axm lists view [flags] <list>
```

### axm lists create

Create a curated extension list

```bash
axm lists create [flags] <list>
```

### axm lists update

Update a curated extension list

```bash
axm lists update [flags] <list>
```

### axm lists delete

Delete a curated extension list

```bash
axm lists delete [flags] <list>
```

### axm lists add

Add an extension to a list

```bash
axm lists add [flags] <list> <extension>
```

### axm lists remove

Remove an extension from a list

```bash
axm lists remove [flags] <list> <extension>
```

## Requirements

- registry
- network

## Side effects

None.
